title: Record the aggregate idle histogram gap
body:
## Summary
- At the per-call ceiling `1688603446527/10^15`, the aggregate idle histogram `{51:4647, 27:1}` has certified moment below one, while 144 copies of `{51:32, 14:1}` have certified moment above one. Both have idle mass 237024.
- The aggregate histogram's own bracket is `1690044548222/10^15` to `1690044548223/10^15`. The selected saving stays below that lower endpoint, and the selected kappa is unchanged.
- Partial result, no new kappa. The per-call histogram in PR #3737 stays as published.
